name: @ramkrishna2003/mcp
stderr:
Usage: mcphub [options] [command]

CLI for MCP Hub — interact with your registered APIs

Options:
  -V, --version                 output the version number
  -h, --help                    display help for command

Commands:
  login [options]               Authenticate with MCP Hub
  add [options] <target>        Add a server from MCP Hub by name, SSE URL, or
                                OpenAPI URL
  list [options]                List all available MCP servers in MCP Hub
  tools <server>                List all tools/functions available for a
                                registered MCP server.
  call <server_or_tool> [tool]  Invoke a tool on a registered MCP server with
                                provided parameters.
  ask <query>                   Ask any natural language question to your Hub
                                of APIs.
  install <server-name>         Install an MCP server schema from MCP Hub
  run <server> <tool>           Run a tool on an installed MCP server
  help [command]                display help for command
